title: 第278章 良善之辈恕不招待第277章 外府执事
slug: 转世成女开局攻略气运之子
content_zh:
半月后。
南域边陲，一片荒芜的赤色戈壁上。
狂风卷着沙砾，打在黑色斗篷上沙沙作响。
林尘独自走在戈壁滩上，脚下的赤色土壤干硬开裂。
这半个月来，他几乎没有走过一条平坦的大道。
专挑那些穷山恶水、盗匪横行的地方走。
“嗖！”
几道尖锐的破空声突然从侧后方袭来。
林尘头也没回，脚下步伐一错，身法运转自然。
三根淬着幽蓝毒液的袖箭擦着他的残影飞过，深深钉入前方的岩石中，冒出阵阵白烟。
“反应倒挺快。”
沙丘后面转出五个蒙面人，手里各自拿着奇形怪状的兵刃。
领头的是个光头，身上散发着初入神藏的气息。
“小子，把储物袋留下，大爷留你个全尸。”
光头扛着一把九环大刀，狞笑着走上前。
林尘停下脚步，转过身。
这几天赶路，这已经是第四拨劫匪了。
南域边陲的治安，除了有徐家镇守的地方，其余皆算是未开化之处。
当然，严格意义上来讲，此地也并非是乾武王朝的领土所在。
正好拿来练手。

林尘没有废话，右手五指微张，一团青蓝火焰在掌心跳跃。
“苍炎玄火！”
光头脸色大变，显然认出了这火焰不凡。
“点子扎手，并肩子上！”
五个劫匪同时扑向林尘。
林尘不退反进，体内真元疯狂涌动，顺着经脉汇聚到右手食指。
“炎魔指！”
一指点出，却是那苍蓝火焰，瞬间变作血色。
而后，那血色的火焰，竟是不断壮大，化作一道狰狞的魔影，
带着狂暴的毁灭气息，直奔光头面门。
光头大惊失色，慌忙举起九环大刀格挡。
“铛！”
一声脆响。
精钢打造的大刀在接触到炎魔指的瞬间，
直接被恐怖的高温融化成铁水。
魔影去势不减，瞬息洞穿了光头的胸膛。
光头连惨叫都没来得及发出，整个人便化作一团飞灰。
剩下的四个劫匪，一时间皆是被吓得呆愣在了原地，
待反应过来后，一个个都是转身便跑。
然而，深谙斩草要除根的道理，

林尘岂能放过四人？
手腕一翻，掌心火焰猛地往地上一按。
下一瞬，赤色的戈壁滩轰然开裂，
四道暗红色的火柱冲天而起，精准地将逃跑的四个劫匪吞噬。
短短几个呼吸，战斗结束。
content_en:
Half a month later.
On the border of the Southern Territory, on a barren red desert.
The strong wind carried the gravel, rustling on the black cloak.
Lin Chen walked alone on the Gobi Desert. The red soil under his feet was dry and cracked.
In the past half month, he had hardly walked on a flat road.
Choose only those places where there are poor mountains and rivers and where bandits are rampant.
"Whoosh!"
Several sharp cracks in the air suddenly struck from the side and behind.
Lin Chen didn't even look back, his steps moved wrongly, and his body movements moved naturally.
Three sleeve arrows quenched with blue venom flew past his afterimage, nailing deeply into the rock in front, emitting bursts of white smoke.
"The response was pretty quick."
Five masked men emerged from behind the dune, each holding strange-shaped weapons in their hands.
The leader was a bald man, exuding the aura of someone who had just entered the divine realm.
"Boy, leave the storage bag, I will keep your whole body."
The bald man carried a nine-ringed sword and walked forward with a sinister smile.
Lin Chen stopped and turned around.
On the road in the past few days, this is already the fourth group of robbers.
Except for the areas guarded by the Xu family, the security on the border of the Southern Territory is considered uncivilized.
Of course, strictly speaking, this place is not the territory of the Qianwu Dynasty.
Just in time to practice.
Lin Chen didn't talk nonsense. He opened the five fingers of his right hand slightly, and a blue flame danced in the palm of his hand.
"Cangyan Xuanhuo!"
The bald man's face changed drastically, and he obviously recognized this extraordinary flame.
"The ideas are in your hands, shoulder to shoulder!"
The five robbers pounced on Lin Chen at the same time.
Lin Chen did not retreat but advanced, the true energy in his body surged crazily, converging along the meridians to the index finger of his right hand.
"Fire Demon Finger!"
As soon as he pointed it out, the blue flame instantly turned into blood.
Then, the bloody flame continued to grow and turned into a ferocious demonic shadow.
With a violent aura of destruction, he went straight to the bald face door.
The bald man turned pale with fright, and hurriedly raised his nine-ring sword to block.
"Cang!"
There was a crisp sound.
The moment the sword made of fine steel came into contact with the Balrog's finger,
It was directly melted into molten iron by the terrifying high temperature.
The demonic shadow continued unabated and instantly penetrated the bald head's chest.
Before the bald man could even scream, his whole body turned into a ball of ashes.
The remaining four robbers were all frightened and froze on the spot.
After reacting, everyone turned around and ran away.
However, I know well that cutting off the weed requires eradicating the root.
How could Lin Chen let the four of them go?
With a flip of his wrist, the flame in his palm slammed to the ground.
The next moment, the red Gobi Desert suddenly cracked,
Four dark red pillars of fire rose into the sky, swallowing up the four escaping robbers with precision.
In just a few breaths, the battle was over.
